compile_procedure: K=6 candidates: the incumbent directive + 5 mutations. Each mutation = the incumbent directive with ONE typed amendment drawn from the error examples: (m1) an explicit duty-cycle/PWM-pricing derivation rule (every duty-cycle or PWM figure must carry its derivation from the permitted measurements with the formula, or cite the datasheet parameter it comes from); (m2) a no-introduction clause (the fix must NOT introduce any new numeric claim, parameter or operating point not present in the ORIGINAL bill); (m3) the input-rule tightened with an explicit sensor-source checklist; (m4) m1+m2 combined; (m5) a minimal-diff clause (change ONLY the sentences the findings touch, keep every other sentence byte-identical where possible)
fitness: (a) introduced defects: delivered defects on the 12 frozen bills under the UNCHANGED canonical detector, FEWER is better; (b) heal rate: surfaced findings actually healed (the post-review scan on the same items), must not regress the incumbent's; (c) length ratio ~1.0 (a directive that shrinks bills to dodge the detector fails the length gate)
selection_rule: Pareto front on (a,b,c); if >1 non-dominated, pick the fewest introduced defects, then highest heal rate. Deterministic, typed BEFORE the run (no post-hoc metric choice).
